depends_on.name: filenavigator_id
depends_on.documentation: The file navigator that produced this manifest. REQUIRED, and RESTORED: this is the edge NDI actually writes, which V_eta had dropped in favour of an invented `epochid`.

depends_on.name: epoch_id
depends_on.documentation: The epoch these files were ingested for. Replaces the invented `epochid` edge, which was empty on all 6,921 documents.

fields.name: files
fields.documentation: List of file references ingested for this epoch. Entries are either NDI-scheme URIs (e.g., 'epochid://t00001') or absolute filesystem paths to the source files. Length varies per epoch (3-6 entries seen in the discovery corpora).
